thread:
mira.sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeHealth POC goes live next Tue. They want a Dedicated endpoint but their outbound IPs rotate (bastion jumpboxes). Also asked whether POC traffic counts toward a Reserved capacity commit. Need options we can give infra + security.
sam.eng: We can spin up a short-term Dedicated pool specifically for the POC (2–4 weeks) and allocate static egress IP(s) from our side. That avoids having them change their firewall every rotation. If they cannot accept our static egress, we have two patterns:
1) Customer NAT -> static Elastic IP (recommended)
2) TLS SNI allowlist + short-lived JWT tokens (works for some customers but needs infra changes)
jordan.networking: To expand — if their side rotates outbound IPs frequently, the recommended pattern is to NAT to a stable egress IP range. If they literally cannot provide that, we can do an SNI-based allowlist but note: SNI-only is weaker (no client cert). mTLS is supported for Private/VPC installs and for Dedicated endpoint in a Private deployment (we can terminate client certs at the edge only in Private mode).

liz.solutions: Sales ops note: For commercial terms, we can exclude pre-sales POC usage from a future Reserved commitment if we include a short POC addendum. I’ll confirm with finance but we've done this before — typically we either: (A) provide credits, or (B) classify POC pool as non-counting for the first 30 days. cc @ana-security for questionnaire callbacks. :+1:

ana-security: For the security questionnaire: TLS 1.2/1.3 enforced, mutual TLS available for Private deployments, audit logs + request traces in the Console, customer-managed KMS support for Private, and SOC/ISO docs can be shared via the secure portal. Regarding egress allowlisting: for Dedicated pools we typically publish a small set of stable egress IPs (usually a /32 per pool) — we can provide the concrete values once the pool is provisioned. mTLS client certs require coordination and CA info from the customer.

mira.sales: They asked for a quick snippet to hand to their infra team. Can someone paste an example allowlist + curl test they can run?

sam.eng: Sure — example allowlist lines and a quick curl test:

```
# Example allowlist entries (replace with our assigned IPs)
203.0.113.18/32  # dedicated egress IP (control plane)
203.0.113.19/32  # dedicated egress IP (data)

# Basic smoke test against Dedicated endpoint
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://dedicated-us.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b", "input":"hello"}'
```

sam.eng: If they want mTLS (client certs), provide their CA cert in PEM and we’ll add the CA to the allowed client CAs for the pool (Private only). If they want SNI-only, they need to allow `*.redwood.ai` hostnames in addition to our egress IPs.
jordan.networking: Quick operational checklist to send them — paste into thread for copy/paste:

- Decide pattern: static egress IP (preferred) OR SNI/JWT pattern
- If static IP: confirm CIDR(s) to allowlist and provide target dates
- If SNI/JWT: confirm which hostnames and token rotation cadence
- If mTLS (Private): exchange CA cert and test certs
- Confirm POC window and whether they want the pool to be non-billable / excluded from commit

liz.solutions: I'll draft the POC addendum and ping finance. Action items for sales rep: get the infra contact + whether they can provide a NATed static EIP. If not, get the allowed hostnames and whether they can accept JWT tokens for short-lived allowlisting.
mira.sales: Thanks — can we also confirm rotation policy if we give them static EIPs? They asked how often we rotate our egress (do we rotate at all?).

ana-security: Our assigned egress IPs for Dedicated pools are stable for the life of the pool unless there's maintenance or security incident. We will only change them with notice (we have a rotation/incident process that notifies customers 48–72h ahead for non-emergency changes).
deploy-bot: [deployment] dedicated-pool/prod-poc-acmehealth created by @sam.eng — pool-id: p-0a1b2c3d — static-egress: 203.0.113.18, 203.0.113.19

mira.sales: Perfect — I'll send the allowlist snippet and the checklist to AcmeHealth infra now and ask legal to sign the POC addendum. Scheduling a 30m handoff call Wed 10am PT to walk through tests. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
